about_the_game:
DELIVERY MUST COMPLETE - Devil May Cry meets Ace Combat. a high speed Acelike Roguelike with SSSTYLE. Cut across cel-shaded, action-packed, arcade-paced dogfights as you fly, fight, and upgrade your roster of kickass planes. Every battle is massive, every location is procedural, and every fight is a spectacle - whether it's aircraft, blimps, dragons or mechs.

Be STYLISH, be a SPECTACLE, be an ACE

Weave, destroy, dodge, and parry everything that comes your way. Earn style points and enhance your style ranking by flying like a true ace. The stage is all yours, show the enemy your moves!

BE THE ARSENAL 

Use missiles, machine guns, lasers, orbital strikes, electric bolts, shotguns, slashing attacks, bouncing railguns, cluster missiles and more! Limited ammo is for chumps! Fire at will, but make sure you don't overheat, overwhelm, or overload yourself as you fight! Equip up to three special weapons at once and go ham! 

A DIFFERENT SKY EACH TIME

Every map is procedurally generated and no two fights are alike: Weather changes, cloud cover variation, terrain anomalies, and random map events among 4 distinct environmental zones change the battlefield each time you play.

BURN THROUGH THE SKIES

Make sharp turns & aggressive plays by Drifting, because angle of attack is just a suggestion to you. Boost forward and cut through clouds, leaving everything in the dust. No, it's not your plane. You are just built different.

COMPLETE YOUR DELIVERY

You're the Courier.

Your mission? Deliver the package.

The destination? Right in the middle of an all-out warzone, where elite fighter squadrons from across the globe swarm the sky all united for the noble goal of glory and peace... with only you to get in their way, again and again and again.

Crashing and burning is just a temporary inconvenience for you, however: Warp tech will pull you back.

No matter how far you fly, no matter how long it takes, no matter how many elite pilots they send after you, nothing will stop you from finishing your goal.

Key features:

  • Fully procedural maps with plenty of random alterations

  • Large variety of weaponry, upgrades, gear, and aircraft

  • 4 distinct zones with unique environments

  • Full voice acting

publishers: It was a dark night after a storm and I had been torn apart from the despair of realizing I needed money to make video games. In my depression, I gazed upon a pristine pool of water on the sidewalk and a beautiful expression gazed back; every inch of his beauty encapsulated in the tiny portal to the realm blessed by his mortal presence. He pulled out his phone with grace and I followed suit - logging onto my bank account and showing that I had money saved up. With his delicate finger he pointed at the number written on the savings account. "This is our budget for the game", his silk-like voice rang. And thus, through his sheer wisdom, the funding for the game was secured. Despite never seeing that absolute sage of a man ever again, I still consider him and his insight into the solution for my troubles deeply integral to the development of this game, and thus, he, in spirit, is my publisher.
